question.text: Futures contracts NOT officially listed on a market are valued at:

answer.text: Net realisable value determined by the independent valuer

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 270, futures or options contracts not officially listed on a market or traded on an unregulated market should be valued at net realisable value using a method determined by the independent valuer. The Trap: Notional value overstates the position, zero understates it, and purchase cost ignores subsequent mark-to-market movement. Note: Hold to the workbook rule — net realisable value as determined by the independent valuer for unlisted or unregulated-market derivative contracts.
